correctness.rationale: TARGET sufficiency as stated (type-preserving Bowditch tree iso plus matched rigid/hanging relative QI implies global QI) omits the finer decorations proved necessary by the cited machine: Cashen-Martin requires relative QI type plus realizability, orientation and stretch factors, and hypotheses of two-ended cylinders and every factor relatively rigid or hanging, none verified for class C. Necessity outline is standard but sufficiency gluing is asserted without uniform constants or stretch matching. Wheel JSJ shape (one rigid orbit, no V2, valence pattern) rests on (A1)/(B1) census only; draft admits (A2)/(A3)/(B2) maximality uncertified, so the computed type-isomorphism claim is not rigorously established.

originality.rationale: Headline iff is a class-C specialization of the published Cashen-Martin reduction of QI classification over two-ended JSJ to relative QI of factors (necessity via Papasoglu/Bowditch, sufficiency via tree-of-spaces with extra decorations), combined with the Dani-Thomas visual identification of peripherals as cut-pair dihedrals. Appendix B already executes the same necessity plus Whitehead rigid-pair analysis for analogous virtually-free rigid groups R_{n+1} with dihedral line patterns. Wheels (virtually F5/F6 with 10/12 dihedrals) are a parameter variant of that subdivided-complete-graph family, and the equivalence adds no substantive implication beyond the prior stronger theorem.

value.rationale: Result is an assembly restating the target question as its own conditional answer: global QI holds iff rigid pairs are relatively QI (modulo hangings), without deciding the admitted wheel pair or producing a new invariant, cutoff, classification, or counterexample. Computed Whitehead min-cut is explicitly non-separating (both 3) and no (non-)relative-QI decision is claimed. Under STANDARD this is a textbook-assembly plus mere parameter substitution and unexplained/incomplete enumeration, not an independently retrievable advance; certification of basic graph hypotheses does not create value.
